objective: Safely stage individually-permitted inputs for future feature ablation; no live collector/model change while Gate 1C is open.

non_negotiable.current_gate: 1C: live predeadline official source, immutable first prediction and matching Git SHA

providers.basis: JMA public website content follows PDL 1.0 unless otherwise marked. Third-party rights/content-specific restrictions still apply.
providers.candidate_manual_input: CSV downloaded from a published JMA download interface
required_checks: document exact CSV format and data availability lag
keep JMA station separate from race venue
retain original CSV bytes SHA256 and attribution
preserve CSV quality/missing/homogeneity fields
no observation revised or first available after race deadline may be a prospective predictor
do not treat daily max wind as instant trackside wind
honor site request limits; no high-frequency scraping

The JMA historical CSV interactive download explicitly asks users to avoid excessive automated-tool access; do not infer unattended scheduled endpoint permission from a manual CSV license; check distribution method separately.

providers.publisher: 統計ダッシュボード（政府統計）
required_checks: choose specific relevant series first
retain attribution and required service notice for public API-powered service
check original dataset rights and geographic meaning
respect API request limits
avoid leakage from revised observations and use effective publication date

providers.registration_required: varies by data use; surveying approval may be needed
required_checks: check selected asset for third-party rights
verify whether survey reproduction/use approval is required
source citation
avoid inferring actual race water wind from geography
confirm AI training/commercial redistribution and bulk download rights in writing or explicit terms
reuse existing 02 offline bridge only after authorization
no Formal Fresh results read while locked

providers.publisher: ボートフロンティア・日和・BOATERS・独自スコア各社
required_checks: public reading is not blanket ingest permission
borrow only general analytical ideas and independent definitions
obtain explicit rights before collecting third-party numerical evaluations

staged_input_contract.source_id: required, equal to a registry provider id
staged_input_contract.publication_or_first_available_at_jst: required; unknown means not prospective eligible
staged_input_contract.race_key: required only when validated race join exists
staged_input_contract.value: missing kept null and never fabricated

guard_sequence: 1) rights and permitted method (manual CSV/API specifics) confirmed
2) immutable raw bytes and provenance with version/date
3) normalize with missing/quality metadata without coercion
4) separate nearby weather station from race venue; audit clocks/publication lag
5) require publication_or_first_available_at < race deadline before prospective race join
6) use same-race/same-number-of-tickets Top3/Top5/Top10 ablation only in 02 after Gate 1C/1D
7) promote only statistically supported changes through 02 research -> 01 production review
8) keep raw and computed features completely isolated from locked Formal Fresh results
feature_groups_to_compare_independently: venue x temperature/precipitation (only if observation time quality adequate)
independently trained head->second and head+second->third interactions
racer opponent-adjusted strength and motor/racer cohort from licensed historical data only
acceptance_proof: No feature is marked useful until time-split and same-cohort held-out Top3/5/10 comparisons improve; no claimed performance improvement as of this manifest.

conditional_auto_activation.objective: After accepted Gate 1D (3 consecutive event days >=99% verified first predeadline saves), automatically prepare/validate approved external-data research ingestion without changing prediction model or Formal Fresh.
trigger_requirements: Latest main BOAT_EDGE_EXECUTION_ORDER.md Gate 1C & 1D accepted with independent per-day live evidence, not just checked boxes or CI.
Three consecutive meeting days each have >=99% success among independently eligible R; all excluded/unknown R disclosed.
Every included R's first immutable Git-add SHA and deadline match; no changed frozen predictions and no unresolved competition.
Official source/prediction/display stability evidenced; formal results remain locked unless independently authorized.
Source-specific rights permit the EXACT machine method, rate, storage, AI training, public attribution and reuse for this field; unknown means DENY.
automatic_followup_sequence: Read current main gate/evidence before acting. Do not create/enable any collector while trigger incomplete.

After evidence passes, re-check permissions and source API/documentation freshness. Start with a genuine machine-readable low-rate API such as registration-free e-Stat dashboard if data relevance is justified; JMA interactive historical CSV does NOT itself grant scheduled bot access.
Prefer existing official or locally available lawful source; no duplicate collector or new cron without verifying existing workflow owner and coverage.

Stage a separate research-lane dry-run ingestion design/PR with request ceiling, exponential backoff, explicit attribution, immutable raw+SHA, publication vs observation timestamps, quality/missing markers, provenance and leakage tests.
Synthetic CI tests and permission guard checks before any live fetch. Preserve encrypted secrets as needed, but never pay or bypass CAPTCHA/auth.

On a permitted endpoint, import only to research storage in a bounded monitored run once the required engineering checks pass, with an off-switch. Never auto-merge to main without reviewed gate and successful checks.
Do not automatically promote any feature to production. Run same-cohort held-out Top3/Top5/Top10 evaluation separately and adopt only supported improvements.
If evidence or rights fails, record reason and remain disabled, without claiming success.
conditional_auto_activation.background_watch_requirement: Separate condition-watch automation checks Gate 1D; it cannot replace a GitHub workflow. Live autonomous ingestion begins only after a real reviewed and deployed collector exists.
